summary: A quiet tape for the book: no held name has a print within 5 trading days, and no held name has a new 8-K beyond WMT's and SAM's already-handled filings. The closest held event is KR's company-confirmed 12-03 call, 7 trading days out (11-26 closed), entering the window on 11-25, now alongside a report that bankers contacted Kroger and Walmart about buying Grubhub. High event risk sits only on names that are not held: ADSK and BBY on 11-24 estimates (approximate; ADSK's is now backed by a Deutsche Bank 'ahead of F3Q earnings' preview) and UNFI on a 12-01 estimate, 5 trading days out. Per L2, every held and menu name below was checked against its own estimate and 7-day filings. Holdings are taken from the 11-20 notes in learning.json because my input carries no positions: WMT, KR, SAM, DPZ, IDXX, INCY, VRSN, CARG, MSCI and TLT; VOO and VTI were sold 11-20; FAST and EXEL sales were approved 11-20 but their fills are not in my input.

notable.headline: Bankers Contact Retailers Regarding Potential Grubhub Deal (11-22); Walmart and Other Retailers Contacted Regarding Potential Grubhub Acquisition (11-23)
notable.read: This touches two held Staples names at once (KR and WMT; Target is also named). It is a sale process sounding out buyers, so there is no bid, price or 8-K, and the most likely outcome for any one contacted retailer is nothing. For KR it adds a capital-allocation question eight sessions before the 12-03 call, on top of the 11-19 baby-food report. Because both held names are exposed to the same story, it is one more reason to treat them as a single Staples bet (L3 is the PM's lesson, not mine; I note the overlap only).

notable.read: This partly answers my 11-20 check on myself after BLBD's stale estimate: a preview written today points to a print that is near, which supports the 11-24 estimate. It still does not confirm the date, so the high flag rests on 'likely inside the window', not on a known date.

notable.headline: FERC Approves Cheniere Energy's Sabine Pass Expansion (11-20)
notable.read: This is the first substantive LNG item since the unexplained 11-17 8-K 1.01/2.03. Regulatory approval for three trains is a real positive catalyst. It makes a project-related financing or contract the more likely reading of that filing. That is still an inference, because no headline names the agreement. Not held.

notable.headline: Acuity Inc. Announces New Term Loan Facility and Amendment (11-22)
notable.read: This explains the 8-K 1.01/2.03 filed 11-20: an up-to-$400M unsecured delayed-draw term loan. A delayed-draw facility is often lined up for an acquisition, but nothing here names one. I close the filing as a financing.

notable.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Walmart Inc. (11-20)

That continues the bullish pre-print drift of 11-10 to 11-18, and the beat-and-raise did not break it. The file now carries a 2027-02-18 next estimate (approximate), which replaces the 'unverified' I carried on 11-19 and 11-20.
